commands.label: ventoy-dl
commands.note: Step 1 of 2: download and extract Ventoy latest from GitHub releases. No UAC needed.
commands.command: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "$r = Invoke-RestMethod 'https://api.github.com/repos/ventoy/Ventoy/releases/latest'; $url = ($r.assets | Where-Object { $_.name -like '*windows*' } | Select-Object -First 1).browser_download_url; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile 'C:\Users\endos\Downloads\ventoy-windows.zip' -UseBasicParsing; Expand-Archive -Path 'C:\Users\endos\Downloads\ventoy-windows.zip' -DestinationPath 'C:\Users\endos\Downloads\ventoy_extracted' -Force"

commands.label: watchdog-reg
commands.command: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "$vbs = '$wsh = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell; $wsh.Run(\"powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -File C:\\Users\\endos\\Signal\\relay\\claude_watchdog.ps1\", 0, $false)'; Set-Content -Path $env:TEMP\watchdog_launch.vbs -Value $vbs; $action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'wscript.exe' -Argument "$env:TEMP\watchdog_launch.vbs"; $trigger1 = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn; $settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -ExecutionTimeLimit 0; Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'ClaudeWatchdog' -Action $action -Trigger $trigger1 -Settings $settings -RunLevel Highest -Force"
